---
title: Real Estate Token
description: Fractional property ownership tokens with rental yield distribution and occupancy tracking.
---

## Overview

`RealEstateToken` represents fractional ownership in a real property. Use cases include Lagos/Nairobi/Accra fractional property investment, rental yield distribution, and developer pre-sales.

**Contract:** `RealEstateToken.sol`  
**CLI template:** `real-estate`  
**SDK method:** `factory.deployRealEstate(opts)`

---

## Metadata Schema

```typescript
interface RealEstateMetadata {
  propertyId:        string;
  propertyType:      string;   // Residential | Commercial | Industrial | Land
  locationAddress:   string;
  totalAreaSqMeters: bigint;
  titleDocumentHash: string;   // bytes32
  valuationUSD:      bigint;   // 18 decimals
  rentalYieldBps:    bigint;   // Annual yield, e.g. 600 = 6%
  occupancyStatus:   string;   // Vacant | Owner-occupied | Tenanted
  developerAddress:  string;   // Developer/issuer Ethereum address
  lastUpdated:       bigint;
}
```

---

## Deploy

```typescript
const result = await factory.deployRealEstate({
  name:        "Victoria Island Commercial Unit",
  symbol:      "VICU",
  assetId:     "PROP-LAGOS-001",
  countryCode: "NG",
  metadata: {
    propertyId:        "PROP-001",
    propertyType:      "Commercial",
    locationAddress:   "12 Adeola Odeku Street, Victoria Island, Lagos",
    totalAreaSqMeters: BigInt(300),
    titleDocumentHash: ethers.ZeroHash,
    valuationUSD:      ethers.parseEther("500000"),
    rentalYieldBps:    BigInt(650),  // 6.5%
    occupancyStatus:   "Tenanted",
    developerAddress:  ethers.ZeroAddress,
    lastUpdated:       BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)),
  },
});
```

---

## Contract-Specific Functions

### Reads

| Function | Returns | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `getMetadata()` | `RealEstateMetadata` | Full metadata struct |
| `valuationUSD()` | `uint256` | Current property valuation |
| `rentalYieldBps()` | `uint256` | Annual rental yield in bps |
| `occupancyStatus()` | `string` | Current occupancy status |
| `totalRentalDistributed()` | `uint256` | Cumulative rental declared (USD, 18 dec) |
| `metadataVersion()` | `uint256` | Metadata update counter |

### Writes (MANAGER\_ROLE)

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `updateValuation(uint256 newValuationUSD)` | Update property valuation |
| `updateOccupancyStatus(string newStatus)` | Update occupancy (Vacant / Tenanted / Owner-occupied) |
| `declareRentalDistribution(uint256 amountUSD)` | Record a rental income distribution event |

---

## Events

```
Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)
MetadataUpdated(uint256 indexed version, uint256 timestamp)
RentalDeclared(uint256 amountUSD, uint256 perTokenUSD, uint256 timestamp)
```
